hook_text: A garden is 12 m by 8 m. Is the fence 20 m, 40 m or 96 m? Only one answer keeps the goats out.
clip_script: Vegetable garden in George! It is 12 m by 8 m. How much fence? Walk around: 12, 8, 12, 8. That is 40 m! Not 20; that is only halfway. Not 96; that is 12 times 8, the space inside. Quick rule: 12 plus 8 is 20, double it: 40. At R35 a metre, that is R1 400. Now the L-shaped garden. Find the missing sides: 6 and 5. Total: 36 m!
visual_style: Aerial view of school gardens with a glowing line tracing each fence, side lengths popping up as it moves.
mood: Practical and upbeat, like a garden makeover show.
pacing: Steady walk around, quick wrong answers crossed out, then the cost reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the fence for the square garden.
